# Khalid Nasser — Entity Brief

Canonical: https://shalimoosavi.github.io/KhaledNasser/
Preferred name: Khalid Nasser
Alternate public spellings: Khalid Nasir; Khaled Nasser
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/khalid_nasser1/

## Verified identity
- Professional boxer and entrepreneur.
- BoxRec lists nationality as Pakistan, birthplace and residence as Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
- Professional debut: 12 September 2020.
- Division: Super Light; stance: Orthodox.

## Current verified record
- Pakistan Boxing Council current profile: 20 wins, 1 loss, 0 draws, 16 KOs, 21 total bouts.
- BoxRec current profile: 20 wins, 1 loss, 0 draws, 16 KOs, 21 bouts; career listed 2020–2026.
- Last verified for this site: 28 September 2026.

## Titles
- WBC Middle East Super Lightweight Title: won 24 November 2023 by fifth-round TKO over Ernest Kapinga.
- WBC Asian Boxing Council Silver Super Lightweight Title: won 19 April 2024 by third-round TKO over Aekkawee Kaewmanee / Patomsith Pathompothong.
- WBC Asian Boxing Council September 2026 rankings: #1 at Super Lightweight.

## Entrepreneurship
- Gulf Today reported in 2022 that Nasser runs Shukran water.
- His public Instagram bio lists Shukran Water, Aqua Kingdom and SK Boxing Kits.
